text:
li: quick recap — brought up halley13b-int4 on a 4-pod canary. raw throughput +10% but two regressions: a small summary-quality drop (F1 -0.7%) and allocator fragmentation after ~6k requests causing sporadic 500s. logs below and proposed mitigations.

park: which quant config? and paste the OOM trace pls.

li: quant: mixed-hybrid -> per-tensor everywhere except attention q/k/v set to per-channel. clip=98.5. OOM snippet: \
[2025-02-10T08:22:12Z] CUDA OOM at alloc 256MB in slab.cc:142\
  kv_cache grow attempt failed (2)\
  prefetch_worker hit pool limit\
\
nora: thanks. sounds like freelist fragmentation. current canary had target_batch=10, slot_reserve=0.04, gen_window=128.

park: infra fixes to try in parallel: (1) increase slot_reserve_fraction to 0.12, (2) reduce target_batch -> 5, (3) enable allocator compaction every 2m, (4) bump prefetch_pool to 12. Also add a soft throttle to avoid forming batches when freelist_frag_ratio > 0.35.

li: implemented 1-4 for canary arm B and left arm A as-is but with clip 97.5. launching A/B at 2% traffic. ci-bot: please run summarization suite and hallucination checks every 30m.

ci-bot: AB started. monitoring hooks: rouge-f1, hallucination-rate, p95_latency, allocator_free_frag_ratio, oom_count. first 30m looks stable but frag_ratio trending up after 40m.

nora: if clip97.5 recovers quality and infra arm B reduces frag spikes, we can consider hybrid default: clip97.5 + slot_reserve 12% + compaction 2m. If both fail, rollback int4 to fp16 for summarization route.

park: also add a routing fallback rule: on_oom -> halley13b-fp16; on_frag_gt 0.4 -> halley13b-int4-softbatch. snippet added to canary routing policy.

li: action items: (a) collect 6h AB matrix and post table, (b) if frag persists add a nightly freelist defrag job during low QPS, (c) consider increasing reserve for KV cache specifically. will update thread with results.

nora: thanks 44d — ping #eng-ml-alerts if rollback triggers.

li: will do.
